g.text: Same games and cooperation heatmap; compare T-switch brackets at each fixed S.
Theory: best responses to each decision’s reported opponent belief. R = 1, P = 0.
Vertical separation shows threshold displacement in normalized T units; overlapping brackets leave agreement unresolved.
Outlines span sampled C-majority → D-majority crossings, not confidence intervals. Paired outlines are slightly offset for visibility.
Arrows: conditional one-sided limits. Symbols above panels: × multiple/reversed crossings; ○ no identifiable crossing.
13 × 13 grid · 2 label blocks · 1,350 valid games / 2,700 decisions · no interpolation or additional API calls.
